Cryptocurrency is recorded on a public ledger, not at a bank. Whoever knows
the seed phrase of a wallet, 12 to 24 English words from the BIP39 list, can
spend what it holds; any BIP39 wallet program opens it.

program the owner used, or look for a BIP39 passphrase, an extra word that
MnemoCode does not keep. Then move everything to a new wallet of your own.
